searchText: I can confirm the last reorg on prater the orphaned block appears as orphaned in the explorer <https://prater.beaconcha.in/slot/3912341> <@602753420033785856> I got this block late but it was head in our node and the slot still had a few seconds to go, the next proposer was LightHouse, was this one of your reorgs? I’m not running any interference on Goerli, think it might just be a slow Lighthouse node striking again No, it may actually be that you got it very late I can check in our clusters At home I got it at 10 seconds yep, Prysm's clusters got that block 13 seconds late funny that I got it so early, perhaps my own node's clock is off 🙂 good to know! or maybe it was produced nearby and propagated poorly? Doubt it, it's a lodestar block. Chances of that close to Brasil are very minimal. But it's true that Goerli is pretty fragmented with a few very large nodes My clock is fine, weird it takes 3 seconds for a block to propagate
